newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Tajik Jan-April GDP rises 5.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Tajik Jan-April GDP rises 5.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Tajikistan's gross domestic product (GDP) rose in the first four months of this year by 5.1 percent yera-on-year, against a fall of 21.2 percent in the sameperiod last year, the State Statistics Committee said on Monday.
Tajikistan's industrial output fell by 10.8 percent in January-April of this year, but the report said the rise in GDP was largely due to fast growth in the private sector of the economy.
